description: High Value Dataset - Rail Points is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tailte Éireann. A Rail Point is a point that indicates either an end point of a railway line, or a point at which there is a transition or junction between railway lines. A rail point also denotes a mile post, as a vertex, on a GDF2 RailNetworkSegment only. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Tailte Éireann. Its tags are Mobility, dgigovernment, high-value-dataset. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
